title: Founder's Office Associate (Business Analyst)
description:
**Job Title:** Founder's Office Associate (Business Analyst)

**Location:** Bengaluru

**Experience:** 1\-3 Years

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Qualification:** B.Tech Preferred

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and analytical Founder's Office Associate to work closely with the Founder on business analysis, MIS reporting, dashboards, presentations, and cross\-functional execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Track business performance, KPIs, targets, and key initiatives.
* Analyze data and provide actionable business insights.
* Prepare MIS reports and dashboards using Advanced Excel.
* Strong knowledge of Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX\-MATCH, Power Query, charts, and data cleaning.
* Prepare business presentations and management reports in PowerPoint.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams and ensure timely execution of initiatives.
* Handle ad\-hoc business analysis and reporting requirements.

**Required Skills:**

* 1\-3 years of experience in Business Analysis, MIS, Founder's Office, or similar roles.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis are mandatory.
* Strong analytical, communication, and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Power BI / Google Sheets experience is an advantage.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* What is your Current Salary? Mention in LPA
* What is your Expected Salary? Mention in LPA
* How much total experience do you have?
* What is your Notice Period? (We are looking for immediate joiner)

Work Location: In person

description:

### **Job Description**


Role: Head – Operations Excellence \& Business Intelligence

  

Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

  

Location: Whitefield, Bengaluru \| On\-site / Operations Floor

  

Company Description

  

Teleradiology Solutions (TRS) is a pioneer in teleradiology, delivering round\-the\-clock diagnostic radiology reporting and support to hospitals and healthcare providers across India, the US, and other global markets. Founded in 2002 by two Yale\-trained physicians and headquartered in Ardmore, PA, TRS today serves over 150 hospitals across 21 countries. The company pairs a network of board\-certified radiologists — including ABR\-certified specialists — with technology\-driven workflows and its AI\-enabled arm, dAIgnostiX, to deliver fast, accurate, and reliable imaging interpretation. dAIgnostiX is based out of Bengaluru (Whitefield). TRS/dAIX also maintains an active academic focus (www.radguru.net) and ongoing research interests, including AI in radiology.

  

The Opportunity

  

TRS is scaling rapidly, with an ambition to significantly increase daily reading capacity while maintaining high standards of quality, turnaround time and customer experience.

  

As we scale, we need to move from fragmented, function\-specific ways of managing processes and performance to a common operating system for execution — with clear processes, transparent KPIs, disciplined review rhythms and rapid problem\-solving.

  

We are looking for a young, high\-energy, hands\-on builder to establish and lead this capability.

  

This is not a traditional PMO role focused on project reports, PowerPoint presentations or following up on action trackers. You will work directly with operating teams, spend significant time on the floor, understand how work actually flows, identify bottlenecks, build the tools and processes required to fix them, and personally drive implementation.

  

You will work closely with the COO and operating leaders across Production Operations, ABR Experience and Customer Management.

  

What You Will Own

  

1\. Build the TRS Operations Management System

  

Create a common methodology for managing operational improvement across functions, replacing fragmented trackers and review mechanisms with:

  

* Standard operating and improvement methodology
* Common project and action tracking
* Clearly defined owners, milestones and escalation mechanisms
* Standard daily, weekly and monthly operating reviews
* Consistent problem\-solving using Lean / Six Sigma principles
* Clear visibility of progress, risks, bottlenecks and outcomes
* The expectation is to build and establish the system, not simply recommend it.

  

2\. Build the Operations KPI \& Performance Dashboard

  

Own the design, development and ongoing management of a live operations dashboard covering key dimensions such as:

  

* Productivity and throughput
* RVUs / readings per day and leading indicators
* ABR capacity and utilization
* SLA / turnaround\-time performance
* Customer escalations
* Employee / ABR satisfaction
* Improvement\-project performance

  

The successful candidate should be comfortable going beyond defining dashboard requirements and should be capable of building the first working version personally.

  

3\. Establish Daily Management Discipline

  

Design and run the operating cadence across the key operating functions. This includes:

  

* Daily operational reviews
* Weekly performance and improvement reviews
* Monthly business reviews
* Clear escalation mechanisms
* Action tracking and closure
* Identification of emerging risks before they become operational issues

  

The role is responsible for the quality and effectiveness of these reviews, not simply scheduling meetings and circulating minutes.

  

4\. Own the End\-to\-End Value Stream

  

Develop and continuously improve the end\-to\-end value stream for diagnostic interpretation:

  

Client order Assignment Case loading Reading Proofing Sign\-out Delivery

  

Identify and quantify:

  

* Bottlenecks
* Queues and waiting time
* Capacity constraints
* Rework
* Handover losses
* Routing / assignment inefficiencies
* Root causes of SLA and customer issues

  

You should be able to conduct a Gemba walk, map the process, analyse the data and translate the findings into practical interventions.

  

5\. Turn Pilots into Scaled Operating Practices

  

A key part of the role will be taking successful improvement pilots and converting them into repeatable, scalable operating processes. For example, where a routing or assignment intervention demonstrates measurable improvement at one site or for one workflow, you will:

  

* Understand why it worked
* Standardize the process
* Define the SOP and controls
* Build the tracking mechanism
* Train the teams
* Pilot and measure
* Scale across the organization
* Monitor sustainability

  

You will work directly with the people performing the work — including assigners, case loaders, readers and proofers — rather than managing implementation remotely through presentations.

  

6\. Build the Team and Process Owner Network

  

Build a small, high\-calibre central team covering:

  

* Process excellence / Lean methodology
* Performance management and analytics
* Project execution

  

In parallel, establish a network of embedded process owners / improvement champions across the operating functions. The objective is to create a small, highly capable central hub that enables improvement across the entire organization, rather than a large PMO.

  

7\. Drive Cross\-Functional Execution

  

The role will work closely with Technology / AI, Quality, Credentialing and other support functions whose actions can directly affect operational performance. You will identify dependencies, establish clear ownership, drive commitments and escalate unresolved issues through the appropriate channels.

  

This requires the ability to influence without formal authority and build credibility with operating and functional leaders.

  

The Profile

  

We are looking for someone who is: young, energetic, analytical, hands\-on, curious, highly organized, data\-driven, comfortable with ambiguity.

  

More importantly, you should be a builder rather than an advisor. You should have demonstrated experience in:

  

* Building a process, operating mechanism, tracker, dashboard or PMO capability from the ground up
* Personally driving an improvement initiative from problem identification through implementation
* Using Lean / Six Sigma or structured problem\-solving methods in a real operating environment
* Taking a pilot or improvement idea and scaling it into standard operating practice
* Working directly with frontline teams to change how work gets done
* Managing multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast\-moving environment
* Driving outcomes without relying on formal authority

  

Lean / Six Sigma

  

A Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt is preferred. The certification itself is less important than demonstrated application of:

  

* Value stream mapping
* Root\-cause analysis
* Process mapping
* Waste identification
* Capacity analysis
* Standard work
* Continuous improvement
* Data\-driven problem solving

**Job Overview:**

  

  

The Supply Chain Analyst is a key contributor in executing and managing inventory replenishment across a global supply network, ensuring seamless flow from multiple TE manufacturing plants to regional Distribution Centers (DCs). This role is accountable for maintaining optimal inventory levels, driving supply reliability, and ensuring customer orders are consistently fulfilled in full and on time (IFOT).
  

Operating in a complex, cross\-regional environment, the analyst partners with Planning, Distribution Operations, Customer Care, and global stakeholders to monitor supply\-demand alignment, resolve critical exceptions, and mitigate operational risks. While primarily execution\-focused, the role requires proactive problem\-solving, data\-driven decision\-making, and process improvement, enabling continuous enhancements in inventory performance, service levels, and operational efficiency.
  

The position demands strong analytical capability, advanced system proficiency, and effective cross\-functional collaboration, with exposure to global supply chain operations and opportunities to take on higher\-level responsibilities and leadership initiatives. This role provides a foundation for progression into senior or strategic supply chain roles within the organization.

o Act as a key interface across Customer Care, Logistics, and Planning teams to ensure seamless order fulfillment and a consistent customer experience.
  

o Ensure customer orders are delivered in full and on time (IFOT) by actively monitoring order flows, identifying risks early, and executing corrective actions.
  

o Lead resolution of complex supply and order exceptions, minimizing disruption to customer commitments and ensuring proactive risk mitigation.
  

o Serve as an escalation point for critical supply issues, coordinating cross\-functional responses and influencing timely decision\-making.
* Operational Excellence \& Supply Coordination

o Own end\-to\-end replenishment strategy and execution for assigned plants and Distribution Centers across regions, ensuring optimal inventory positioning and service levels.

o Manage and optimize system utilization (e.g., SAP and planning tools), ensuring master data accuracy and effective MRP signal execution.
  

o Identify and implement process improvements in replenishment planning, inventory positioning, and exception handling to enhance efficiency and scalability.

description:

TE Connectivity is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. Our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next\-generation transportation, renewable energy, automated factories, data centers, medical technology and more. With more than 85,000 employees, including 8,000 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 140 counties, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS.


**Job Overview:**
  

The Supply Chain Analyst is a key contributor in executing and managing inventory replenishment across a global supply network, ensuring seamless flow from multiple TE manufacturing plants to regional Distribution Centers (DCs). This role is accountable for maintaining optimal inventory levels, driving supply reliability, and ensuring customer orders are consistently fulfilled in full and on time (IFOT).
  

Operating in a complex, cross\-regional environment, the analyst partners with Planning, Distribution Operations, Customer Care, and global stakeholders to monitor supply\-demand alignment, resolve critical exceptions, and mitigate operational risks. While primarily execution\-focused, the role requires proactive problem\-solving, data\-driven decision\-making, and process improvement, enabling continuous enhancements in inventory performance, service levels, and operational efficiency.
  

The position demands strong analytical capability, advanced system proficiency, and effective cross\-functional collaboration, with exposure to global supply chain operations and opportunities to take on higher\-level responsibilities and leadership initiatives. This role provides a foundation for progression into senior or strategic supply chain roles within the organization.

-------------------------------

o Act as a key interface across Customer Care, Logistics, and Planning teams to ensure seamless order fulfillment and a consistent customer experience.

o Serve as an escalation point for critical supply issues, coordinating cross\-functional responses and influencing timely decision\-making.

o Provide guidance and mentorship to junior analysts or team members, supporting capability development and knowledge sharing.
  

o Lead and contribute to cross\-functional and global initiatives, delivering measurable improvements in efficiency, process optimization, and overall customer satisfaction.

description:
**Senior Product Analyst**


**Location:** Bengaluru, HSR Layout


**Employment Type:** Full\-time


**About AppsForBharat**


At AppsForBharat, we are on a mission to assist a billion Indians in their spiritual journey and help them feel happier, more peaceful, and more content.


Our flagship product, **Sri Mandir**, is the world’s largest app for Hindu devotees and serves as a digital sanctuary for millions of devotees worldwide. Through Sri Mandir, users can participate in online pujas, make chadhavas (offerings), and connect with temples across India.


We are building technology\-led experiences for a large and diverse user base and are looking for people who enjoy solving meaningful problems at scale.


**About the Role**


We are looking for a **Senior Product Analyst** with 4–6 years of experience in a B2C/D2C product startup or a similar high\-growth environment.


In this role, you will work closely with Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams to understand user behaviour, identify product opportunities, measure product performance, and turn data into actionable recommendations.


You will go beyond reporting: using data to understand **what is happening, why it is happening, and what we should do next.**


**What You’ll Do**


* Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Analyse key product metrics including **activation, retention, conversion, churn, engagement, and funnel performance**.
* Study user journeys, behaviour, cohorts, and segments to identify opportunities to improve the product experience.
* Plan, analyse, and evaluate **A/B tests and product experiments** and translate results into product decisions.
* Partner closely with **Product, Marketing, and Engineering** teams to define problems, measure impact, and drive data\-backed decisions.
* Define, track, and optimise KPIs across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and overall product performance.
* Identify business and product opportunities through data and provide clear, actionable recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Support strategic planning by identifying potential challenges, opportunities, and trends.
* Conduct relevant market and competitor research to understand user needs and industry trends.
* Identify opportunities to improve analytical processes, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Communicate complex analysis clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**What We’re Looking For**


* **4–6 years** of experience in Product Analytics, Product Analysis, Business Analytics, Growth Analytics, or a similar role.
* Experience working in a **B2C/D2C product company or high\-growth startup**.
* Strong understanding of **product metrics, user behaviour, customer journeys, funnels, cohorts, and retention**.
* Strong **SQL** skills and experience working with large datasets.
* Strong proficiency in **Excel/Google Sheets** and experience with BI tools such as **Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar**.
* Hands\-on experience with **A/B testing and experimentation**.
* Ability to translate data and analysis into **clear, actionable product recommendations**.
* Experience working closely with **Product, Marketing, Engineering, or Growth** teams.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* High ownership and ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment.
* A strong **user\-centric mindset** and curiosity to understand why users behave the way they do.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, understanding users through data, and working closely with product teams to create measurable impact, we'd love to hear from you.


**One Team. One Goal. Assisting millions on their digital devotional journeys.**

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1737618
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**STS Cross\-Function Reporting Analyst**

  


**EY Technology:**



Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 450,000 people in more than 160 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connect to our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated into the client services we deliver and are key to us being more innovative as an organization.

  


**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**



Client Technology (CT) focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.



Enterprise Technology (ET) – ET supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. ET will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on better user experience.



Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protects EY and client data, and our information management systems.

  


**The opportunity**

  



The Cross\-Function Support Reporting Analyst partners closely across the Security Technology Services (STS) organization and Information Security to support and management of Security products and services. This includes analytics and reporting, service reviews, service improvements, service transition, introduction and readiness, and other activities as identified pertaining to end\-to\-end service management of internal security technology offerings.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Analyse and interpret security tools data to generate various reports.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and visualizations to present security metrics to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with various security support teams to gather data and insights for reporting purposes.
* Monitor reports and dashboard to ensure data accuracy and relevance.
* Prepare regular and ad\-hoc reports for management.
* Identify trends and patterns in security data to inform decision\-making.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Conceptual knowledge of security applications and technologies, as well as operating system platforms including Cloud technologies
* Proficiency in Azure Cloud services, with a strong understanding of Azure security tools such as Azure Security Center, Azure Monitor, and Azure Sentinel
* Advanced knowledge in Power BI and connecting it with various data sources, including Azure platform, SQL databases and other models.
* Knowledge in scripting (Python) and API would be an added benefit
* Analytical acumen and solution orientation to provide recommendations to teams and leaders in support of avoiding financial, operational, and security risks to EY and our customers
* Build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of a matrixed, geographically and culturally dispersed organization
* Possess knowledge of the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) to drive compliance in Incident, Problem, and Change processes and drive as necessary

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**


* Degree in Computer Science or related discipline, or equivalent work experience
* 5 \- 7 years working within Information Technology in a global firm
* Advance knowledge in Power BI and DAX
* Knowledge of Azure Data Explorer, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Log Analytics
* Working knowledge of data analysis programming or scripting languages, such as Python (with libraries like pandas, NumPy) or PowerShell
* Experience with Azure SQL and database management systems for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
* Certifications in data visualization or analytics platforms.

  


**What we look for**


* Critical thinking skills demonstrating analytical and systematic approach to problem solving, data quality validation, business insights generation
* Experience working in a global virtual environment
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills
* Experience in Stakeholder Management \& Data Storytelling
* Good judgment, tact, and decision\-making ability
* Ability to understand and integrate cultural differences and motives and to work with cross cultural teams.
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and change, and exercise appropriate time management to meet deadlines
* Ability to work autonomously but also within a team environment where necessary

  


**What working at EY offers**



We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

  


* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The Supply Chain Operations team supports the broader Supply Chain organization through centralized issue management and resolution coordination for operational issues impacting Lowe's field locations and Supply Chain network.

**Job Summary :**


The **Supply Chain Analyst (IM)** is responsible for managing and coordinating the resolution of Supply Chain operational issues raised by Lowe’s field partners.  

  



The Analyst serves as a central point of contact for incoming issues, assessing the request and business impact, performing initial investigation and troubleshooting, and identifying the appropriate Supply Chain, Technology, or cross\-functional team required for resolution. The role maintains ownership of the case through its lifecycle by coordinating across teams, following up on outstanding actions, communicating meaningful updates, and driving issues toward resolution.  

  



This role requires a strong understanding of Supply Chain processes and the ability to connect issues to relevant upstream and downstream processes and systems. The Analyst is expected to look beyond the immediate request to understand the underlying problem, ask the appropriate questions, and provide partner teams with sufficient information to enable effective troubleshooting and resolution.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are building a next\-generation enterprise SaaS platform designed to streamline complex operational workflows across HR, labor management, payroll, revenue management, purchasing, and accounting. We are looking for a Business Analyst who can sit at the intersection of product strategy and engineering execution — someone who turns business intent into sprint\-ready work that a development team can build without ambiguity.

This is a hands\-on, delivery\-focused role. You will work directly with the Product Owner and Technical Lead, own the product backlog, and be the daily bridge between business stakeholders and the engineering team.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Requirements \& Backlog**

* Work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to understand business needs, define requirements, and translate them into actionable backlog items
* Maintain and prioritize the product backlog — always keep N\+3 sprints of refined, ready items ahead of the development team so sprints never start cold
* Prepare additional backlog items proactively based on business needs, dependencies, gaps, and upcoming functionality

**User Stories \& Acceptance Criteria**

* Break down high\-level requirements and epics into precise, buildable user stories
* Write clear acceptance criteria — your stories are the contract between product and engineering, and developers ship without re\-clarification
* Identify dependencies, edge cases, and integration points before stories reach sprint planning

**Agile Ceremonies**

* Conduct backlog refinement sessions with Product Owners, developers, and QA teams
* Participate actively in sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
* Facilitate productive, time\-boxed refinement sessions — you keep the conversation focused and the output actionable

**Process Analysis**

* Analyse existing business workflows and identify opportunities to eliminate manual work, reduce errors, and improve efficiency through the platform
* Document current\-state and future\-state process flows to guide development priorities

**Quality \& Validation**

* Support and validate UAT — you own confirming that what was built matches what was asked for
* Collaborate with QA to ensure test cases align with acceptance criteria
* Participate in defect triage and help distinguish product gaps from scope creep

**WHAT YOU MUST BRING**

* 4–8 years as a Business Analyst on software product delivery — not consulting or documentation only, but actual end\-to\-end sprint delivery
* Proven experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria that development teams ship without constant clarification
* Comfort in Agile/Scrum environments — you know the difference between a story, an epic, and a spike, and you can run a refinement session
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA and Confluence; familiarity with Azure DevOps
* Strong communication skills — you translate between non\-technical stakeholders and engineers fluently, in both directions
* Ability to manage competing priorities and keep multiple sprint queues healthy simultaneously

* Prior work on ERP, HRMS, payroll, or financial software
* Familiarity with Figma — you can review UI designs for completeness before development begins
* Experience working with offshore or distributed development teams
* Exposure to API\-driven integrations and an understanding of how third\-party systems connect

We are seeking an experienced data analytics resource to support NTAM’s key analytics initiatives with a strong focus on delivering **robust, scalable, and user\-centric Machine Learning, Business Intelligence and data science solutions**. This role will work closely with architects, data engineers, and business stakeholders to design and develop **enterprise grade reports, dashboards, semantic models, and predictive models.** This resource will also perform **advanced SQL based data preparation and optimization**, while applying **data engineering and AI/ML techniques** to enhance insights.


The role is **primarily BI engineering focused,** with **data engineering and applied ML/AI responsibilities**, and is designed for a senior individual contributor who can **operate independently, own requirements end to end and provide technical leadership** within a global delivery model.


This role is ideal for a hands\-on resource who is strong in **semantic modeling, performance optimization, and stakeholder engagement**, and can adapt quickly across complex, multidomain analytics initiatives in the **banking and financial services** space. Prior **Asset Management experience** and a working knowledge of financial data will also be critical.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop **Power BI reports, dashboards, and executive scorecards** aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Lead the design, build, and optimization of **semantic models (tabular)** using best practice data modeling and efficient DAX measures.

* Expertlevel **SQL** skills — advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and performance tuning.

* Strong proficiency in **Microsoft Power BI**, including DAX, Power Query (M), semantic modeling, and visualization best practices.

* Validate product data mappings, conversions, interfaces, and deployment readiness.
* Support mock conversions, cutover activities, and post\-deployment validation.

* Partner with Product Creation, Merchandising, Planning, Sourcing, Supply Chain, PLM, MDM, PIM, SAP, and Integration teams to resolve product data issues.
* Provide guidance on SAP product and article data requirements, business rules, and downstream system impacts.
* Support global projects by ensuring product data changes are evaluated for their impact across the end\-to\-end technology landscape.
* Partner with the Enterprise Data Governance team to support enterprise data standards and quality initiatives.

### **Continuous Improvement**


* Analyze recurring product and article data issues and drive root cause resolution.
* Develop documentation, validation procedures, and best practices for enterprise product data.
* Identify opportunities to automate product data validation and improve operational efficiency.
* Develop reporting and metrics to monitor product data quality and readiness across the enterprise.

title: Global Banking & Market - Vendor Management(TPRM) - Analyst - Bengaluru
description:
WHO WE ARE

  

  

The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and high\-net\-worth individuals. The firm is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in London, Frankfurt, Tokyo, Hong Kong, India and other major financial centers around the world.  



  

GLOBAL BANKING \& MARKETS  



  

Our core value is building strong relationships with our institutional clients, which include corporations, financial service providers, and fund managers. We help them buy and sell financial products on exchanges around the world, raise funding, and manage risk. This is a dynamic, entrepreneurial team that includes individuals who have a passion for the markets and who thrive in fast\-paced, changing environments and are energized by a bustling trading floor. At Goldman Sachs, our culture is one of teamwork, innovation, and meritocracy. We often say our people are our greatest asset and we take pride in supporting each colleague both professionally and personally. From collaborative workspaces and ergonomic services to wellbeing and resilience offerings, we offer our professionals the flexibility and support they need to reach their goals in and outside the office.  



  

YOUR IMPACT  



  

Do you have a deep subject matter expertise and a passion for risk management? We’re looking for a professional to join our First line Risk Management team within the Global Banking and Markets (GBM) Division. In this role, you would partner with front to back business units supporting our client franchise to manage and improve our operational risk \& resilience, particularly related to Third\-Party Risk Profile. Your opportunity for high visibility impact includes analyzing the key risks and controls managed by GBM, applying risk management tools to monitor and communicate to the leadership group on these risks, associated remediation plans, and sharing best practices to continuously improve Risk management culture and the control environment.  



  

OUR IMPACT  



  

The GBM Third Party Risk Management \& Strategy team within GBM oversees the control framework and guides GS managers implement oversight on a broad spectrum of processes managed by Third Parties. The Risk Control position in GBM Third Party Risk Management \& Strategy team provides an opportunity for a dynamic and risk\-aware individual to take part in shaping GBM’s Third Party control framework related to a broad spectrum of firm policies and processes. The role is part of a team responsible for overseeing aspects of Risk Management, Policy Implementation, Quality Assurance, Audit facilitation and relative analytics for the GBM teams. The successful candidate will be able to exercise independent judgment, discretion, and decision\-making.  



  

HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL  



  

* Supporting the divisions to ensure compliance with the firms Vendor Management (VM) programs
* Understanding of well recognized risk management frameworks and a proven track record of implementation
* Working knowledge of the regulatory landscape and its applicability to the vendor ecosystem
* Managing vendor profiles, performing oversights and co\-ordinate with Vendor relationship owners on\-boarding/off\-boarding and incident management of divisional third\-party vendors
* Consistently deliver on monthly/ quarterly deadlines on divisional risk management requirements
* Contribute to developing and enhancing quality assurance framework, processes and procedures
* Co\-ordinating with stakeholders across the organization (e.g. compliance, technology) to support deliverables
* Support in performance monitoring and reporting to divisional stakeholders on VM activities, including outstanding risks, incidents and control measures
* Supporting the divisions to ensure compliance with the firms Vendor Management (VM) programs
* Acts as a culture carrier by embedding in the team or region; propagates a risk mind\-set and awareness of Operational Risk
* Build data tracking and management tooling which can be leveraged for reporting to senior stakeholders
* Strong knowledge of information security technologies such as identity and access management, Encryption and multi factor authentication, penetration test and patch management
* Experience completing control reviews, risk assessments, scenario analysis, incident / event post\-mortems assessment and other similar assessment methodologies
  

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS  



  

This role requires an energetic self\-starter that can liaise across Global Banking and Markets both regionally and globally. Solid understanding of the global markets franchise offered by the firm and experience within a risk management context are required. Strong interpersonal and analytical skills along with an interest in the broader control environment within financial services are essential to succeed in this role.
  

* 1–3 years of experience in financial banking/vendor management/risk management or banking operations
* Proficient in MS Office applications especially Excel (pivot table, V\-lookup functions) etc.
* Knowledge of Third\-Party Due Diligence processes (onboarding, ongoing and termination)
* Fast learner, good analytical skills with attention to detail
* Highly organised, ability to work to tight corporate deadlines, whilst under pressure without compromising accuracy
* Understanding of the different risk domains pertaining to third parties would be an added advantage
* Passion for delivering and promoting quality in all aspects of your work and applying professional judgement

Working under the supervision of Senior Associates/Managers to gather and organise evidence, extract and reconcile data, you’ll refresh dashboards and prepare draft summaries that support reviews, thematic work, events/issues analysis and governance packs.

  

You’ll contribute to efficiency and repeatability by maintaining and running approved templates, scripts and automation steps (where authorised), escalating data quality issues and tool/access concerns promptly, and ensuring all outputs are quality\-checked and reviewed before use in governance.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst - Procurement - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
description:
### **About the Role**



Equinix is seeking a highly motivated **Senior Business Systems Analyst** to join our Bangalore office. In this role, you will serve as the functional and systems expert for Source to Pay processes and technology solutions, partnering closely with Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, IT, and other business stakeholders to drive process excellence and digital transformation.



You will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, designing scalable P2P solutions, optimizing Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) processes, and supporting global procurement initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion with exceptional analytical, stakeholder management, and solution design skills.



The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering business value through process standardization, automation, system enhancements, integrations, and adoption of best\-in\-class procurement practices that support Equinix's global operations.


### **Key Responsibilities**



 Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Financials and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) processes across global business units.



 Partner with Finance, Accounts Payable, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Operations, and IT stakeholders to gather, analyze, document, and prioritize business requirements.



 Translate business requirements into functional designs, process improvements, solution architectures, and implementation roadmaps.



 Lead end\-to\-end Oracle Cloud/EBS functional initiatives spanning Procure\-to\-Pay, Accounts Payable, General Ledger integration points, Supplier Risk Management, Purchasing, and Financial Operations.



 Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on process optimization, automation, controls, compliance, and operational efficiency.



 Analyze current\-state business processes and identify opportunities for standardization, simplification, and digital transformation across finance and procurement functions.



 Facilitate requirements workshops, fit\-gap analyses, solution design sessions, process mapping exercises, and stakeholder reviews.



 Configure, support, and enhance Oracle Financials and Procurement modules, including system testing, deployment, and post\-production support.



 Collaborate with technical teams, integration teams, reporting teams, and third\-party vendors to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.



 Support and coordinate integrations between Oracle ERP and upstream/downstream systems, including banking, supplier, tax, reporting, and other enterprise applications.



 Lead data conversion, reconciliation, system validation, SIT/UAT testing, defect resolution, and change management activities during implementations and enhancements.



 Develop and maintain business process documentation, functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and operational procedures.



 Design and support reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics that provide visibility into financial and operational performance.



 Partner with business leaders to recommend best\-practice solutions aligned with Oracle capabilities, governance standards, and evolving business needs.



 Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive timely resolution of functional and process\-related challenges.



 Support period\-end close activities, financial controls, audit requirements, and compliance initiatives related to P2P processes.



 Provide mentorship to junior analysts and consultants while contributing to functional competency development across Finance and ERP domains.



 Stay current with Oracle ERP capabilities, emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices across Finance, P2P, and enterprise business processes.


### **Required Qualifications**



 Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field.



 8\+ years of experience as an Oracle Functional Consultant, Business Systems Analyst, ERP Analyst, or Functional Lead supporting Finance and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) business processes.



 Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle ERP Cloud and/or Oracle E\-Business Suite, including Purchasing, Accounts Payable, Supplier Management, General Ledger integrations, and Procurement modules.



 Deep understanding of end\-to\-end Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Accounts Payable (AP), Supplier Management, Financial Controls, and ERP business processes.



 Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications, process designs, configuration solutions, and implementation roadmaps.



 Proven track record leading Oracle ERP implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and business transformation initiatives.



 Strong knowledge of finance and procurement controls, approval workflows, compliance requirements, audit support, and business governance practices.



 Experience supporting enterprise application integrations between Oracle ERP, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Banking, Tax, and third\-party systems.



 Hands\-on experience with configuration, testing, SIT/UAT coordination, defect management, production support, and release management activities.



 Strong understanding of Oracle reporting, analytics, dashboards, and KPI development to support business decision\-making.



 Experience with data conversion, data migration, reconciliation, and master data management activities.



 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and business process improvement skills.



 Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery environments.



 Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations.



 Ability to work effectively with global teams across multiple regions and time zones.



 Oracle Cloud certification in Procurement, Financials, or related Oracle ERP modules is preferred.



 Experience leading or supporting Oracle Cloud ERP implementation and transformation programs.



 Knowledge of complementary enterprise applications such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, Ivalua, GEP, Concur, BlackLine, or other finance/procurement platforms is a plus.



 Experience with integrations, APIs, middleware platforms, and enterprise architecture frameworks.



 Strong understanding of Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, and Shared Services business processes.



 Experience supporting month\-end close, financial operations, audit readiness, and compliance initiatives.



 Project management, change management, and stakeholder engagement experience preferred.



How You will find success


* Cultivate a strong sense of curiosity and a product\-focused mindset.
* Collaborate effectively with managers, cross\-functional teams, and teammates to achieve shared goals.
* Demonstrate persistence, creativity, and an unwavering drive to deliver results.
* Take pride in ownership and consistently strive for excellence in every initiative.

title: Sr. Manager/Manager - Supply Chain Analytics
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  

About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.
  
We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.
  
Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.
  
We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.
  
If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  

About Your Role at Lilly
  
At Lilly, every function has a role in getting medicines to patients.
  
Some build the science.
  
Others build the organisation that makes the science possible.
  
At Lilly in Bengaluru, the Supply Chain function is the infrastructure that allows scientists, engineers, and commercial professionals to do the work that reaches patients.
  
Your work is part of that chain.
  
  

Job Description
  
This role is part of the Business Intelligence Center of Excellence (COE), a global team that leverages advanced analytics capabilities to enable the achievement of Global Supply Chain (GSC) objectives.
  
  

This role will provide technical expertise across supply chain analytics, planning, and global logistics for manufacturing sites, affiliates, hubs, regions, and zones. Candidate requires a strong understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain processes combined with advanced analytical skills like statistical modelling, AI/ML and data engineering concepts.
  
  

This role will lead and deliver high\-impact projects that enhance operational efficiency and support data\-driven decision\-making across the global supply chain. Responsibilities include driving cross\-functional collaboration, managing stakeholders, identifying and mitigating risks, and effectively communicating project status, milestones, and key deliverables.
  
  

This role also contributes to supply chain transformation initiatives including NexGen programs and works closely with GSC teams to streamline operations through analytics and automation.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide advanced analytical expertise to Global Supply Chain (GSC) stakeholders, with a strong focus on optimizing processes, systems, and tools used to manage products across complex supply networks.
* Design, develop, and deliver enterprise\-grade Power BI dashboards that enable real\-time visibility into key supply chain KPIs, including inventory health, service levels, and logistics performance across global operations.
* Translate complex and high\-volume supply chain data into clear, actionable insights, empowering stakeholders to make faster, data\-driven decisions.
* Enhance and modernize reporting solutions by improving data accuracy, usability, and self\-service capabilities — reducing manual effort while increasing stakeholder confidence and adoption.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and resolution of issues within reporting and analytics solutions to ensure reliability, continuity, and accuracy of business\-critical insights.
* Build and operationalize scalable ETL pipelines and robust semantic data models that integrate data across ERP, planning, and logistics systems.
* Support and contribute to strategic data initiatives, including EWM, TMS and Enterprise Data Lake (EDB), ensuring standardized, clean, and well\-governed data flows across platforms.
* Identify and implement automation opportunities for recurring and ad hoc data processes using tools such as Power Automate, Python, and SQL, reducing cycle time and manual dependencies.
* Act as the primary technical advisor to GSC stakeholders, providing guidance on supply chain systems, analytics tools, and end\-to\-end product flow management.
* Collaborate with global planners, operations teams, and IT partners to deliver cross\-functional analytics initiatives with measurable business impact.
* Proactively identify gaps in data, processes, and tools, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and performance across supply networks.
* Develop optimization models and scenario\-planning solutions to support strategic decision\-making across affiliates, distribution networks, and manufacturing sites.


Basic Qualifications
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Data Science, or a related field.


Experience
  
  

* 5–10 years in supply chain analytics, planning, or a related domain.


Language
  
  

* Proficiency in English (required).


Preferred Skills \& Experience
  
  

* Experience in Pharma / Life Sciences; manufacturing site exposure is a plus.
* APICS / CSCP certification preferred.
* Strong expertise in data visualization and transformation tools: Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, DAX, Power Query.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP and planning systems: Kinaxis, SAP IBP, EWM, TMS.
* Advanced analytics skills using AI/ML, SQL, Python/R.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a global, matrixed organization.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* High level of initiative, ownership, and ability to lead teams and manage ambiguity.


At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients.
  
It is how we work.
  
We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work.
  
This is not just a policy.
  
It is who we are.

description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. We stand for our values, building long\-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.


**About the Role**

Position Title: **Market and Liquidity Risk Analyst**

Corporate Title: **Analyst**

Reporting to: **Senior analyst / VP / Director**

Location: Bengaluru


**Job Profile**

**Position details**

The role will be a hybrid role in market and liquidity risk management. Market risk management tasks will involve performing PnL and risk data generation and reporting, analysing and monitoring market risk activities undertaken by Global Markets (Trading) and Treasury (ALM). Liquidity risk management will mainly be enhancing Liquidity risk management practices and control functions for Asia branches.


This is a branch second line role, reporting into the regional market and liquidity risk management team overseeing and supporting Asia individual branches (ex. Japan and China) to uplift branch market and liquidity risk management. The person will be responsible for reporting, escalating and resolving risk related issues for local branch risk managers’ attention and support the local branch risk managers in carrying out their review and challenge function as a second line of defense in the bank.


The scope of products includes interest rate and FX related products such as interest rate swaps, FX swaps, CCS, Options, Bonds, on\-balance sheet loans, deposits and inter bank borrowing/lending.


**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Market Risk**

* Prepare daily, monthly and periodic risk reports and perform PnL, VaR and risk exposures analysis for the bank’s trading and treasury portfolio
* Monitor individual dealer’s position and PL and market risk greeks such as delta, PV01, gamma, vega, theta
* Perform market risk stress testing and daily VaR back\-testing and analysis
* Prepare and monitor various daily trade reconciliation and monitoring reports
* Capturing daily market data and ensuring integrity and accuracy of market data before uploading into front systems for day\-end revaluation process
* Monitor benchmark submissions (e.g. SOR, SORA for Singapore)
* Prepare daily market conduct check reports for the traders/dealers e.g. off\-price check;
* Monitor, investigate and report market risk limits and credit limits, along with Volcker rule metrics reporting and analysis for Volcker rule compliance
* Support Financial and Head Office reporting requirements

**Liquidity Risk**

* Prepare daily, monthly and other periodic risk reports for reporting to management.
* Prepare data and presentation materials for Asset Liability Management Committee meetings for Singapore and APAC including coordination with stakeholders for committee meetings.
* Regular monitoring including but not limited to liquidity risk indicators, balance sheet, Net Interest Income and stress testing.
* Maintain and improve the systems/infrastructures/EUCs (including update of policies and procedures) for funding liquidity Risk Management

**Second line for Market and Liquidity Risk Management will include but not limited to;**

* Under supervision and guidance from regional and branch risk management teams, support the preparation of materials for ALM/MRM Committee materials, Financial,Head Office and Regulatory reporting
* Work in collaboration with regional or local branch risk managers in handling requirements from internal/external audits and regulatory reviews and providing advisory for market and liqudity risk management activities to internal stakeholders including Global Markets, Treasury, Back\-office
* Work in close partnership with regional risk management team to support ongoing Head Office or regional projects related to market and liquidity risk, including ongoing efforts in process simplification and streamlining and implementation of industry best practices
* Prepare Asia branch specific local reporting for market and liquidity risk
* Performing other responsibilities or other adhoc projects as assigned from time to time

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics or related field preferred
* Preferred MBA/CA
* At least 1 year experience in Banking/Treasury/Risk management is required
* Excellent oral and written communication in English
* Strong knowledge of Python and Excel VBA is required
* Good knowledge of Tableau or Alteryx will be advantageous
* Prior experience in process streamlining, automation and ability to conceptualise automated control solutions is preferred
* Good knowledge of banking and derivatives products is desirable
* Experience in ALM and funding risk management desirable
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment with a strong control mindset
* Takes initiatives to collaborate and challenge status quo, and adaptable to embrace new changes
* Strong communication skills (both verbal \& writing), interpersonal and business analytical skills attributes
* Self\-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and able to work independently to source for information, systematically evaluate options and recommend solutions
* Flexible team player and able to work and deliver under pressure

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long\-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

Trane Technologies is seeking a Data Engineering Analyst to join our ISC Data Architecture \& Governance team based in Bangalore, India. In this role, you will be responsible for ingesting data from internal and external sources into our enterprise data lake, with a strong focus on the bronze layer of a medallion architecture. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data analysts, and technical teams to gather requirements, clarify business logic, support testing, and design practical solutions that improve reliability, usability, and scalability.



The ideal candidate combines strong technical data engineering skills with the ability to work independently, determine next steps, and communicate effectively with customers and stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.



This role is based in our Bangalore, India corporate office and reports directly to the Data Architecture \& Governance Manager for ISC.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integrations, and ETL/ELT workflows on Google Cloud Platform using BigQuery, Airflow, and Cloud Data Fusion.
* Ingest data from internal and external sources into the enterprise data lake, with primary ownership of the bronze layer within a medallion architecture.
* Analyze legacy systems, databases, workflows, and transformation logic to understand current\-state processes, dependencies, and opportunities for modernization.
* Document current\-state data flows and system behavior and develop recommendations for process improvement, architecture simplification, and legacy\-to\-cloud modernization.
* Use strong SQL skills to analyze source data, validate transformations, understand embedded business logic, and support data analysts with trusted datasets.
* Partner with business stakeholders and internal customers to gather requirements, clarify needs, support testing, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
* 3\&\#43; years of experience in data engineering, cloud data platforms, data integration, or related roles.
* Hands\-on experience building data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong working knowledge of BigQuery, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Data Fusion.

title: Analytics Engineering Contractor
description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.


**POSITION SUMMARY**



Join EarnIn's Analytics Engineering team for a 6\-month internship building the data foundation that powers business decisions, and the AI systems that make that data accessible to every analyst at EarnIn. You'll own meaningful end\-to\-end work across two connected workstreams \- data modeling and AI\-powered analytics\- under the guidance of senior analytics engineers. This position is based in Bengaluru, India, with two days a week in\-office required as part of our expanding site location, and is a 6\-month contract engagement with a start date in January 2027\.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Contribute to the Agentic Analytics system, an AI agent that answers business questions by generating and evaluating SQL, by reviewing agent outputs for correctness, curating golden evaluation datasets, and capturing domain business rules that improve the agent's accuracy over time.
* Develop a deep understanding of EarnIn's core business domains to evaluate whether AI\-generated answers are correct for real business questions; your domain judgment is the most valuable input to the system.
* Use AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) throughout both workstreams to develop applied AI skills in a real analytics engineering context.
* Write clean, well\-tested, and well\-documented SQL and Python code that lasts beyond the internship.
* Collaborate with engineers and analysts across the Data team; present your work and learnings to the broader team.


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**


* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree (B.E., B.Tech., M.Tech., or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from an Indian university
* Experience with SQL \- writing queries, understanding data models, working with analytical datasets; coursework or personal projects count.
* Familiarity with Python for data work; classroom or project experience is fine.
* Eagerness to learn and actively use AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as part of your day\-to\-day workflow. This is a core expectation, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Curiosity about how businesses work \- you want to understand why a metric is defined a certain way, not just how to query it.
* Ability to communicate progress proactively, ask good questions, and document your work clearly.
* Self\-starter mindset \- you take initiative, seek feedback, and iterate quickly with moderate guidance.
* Prior internship or project experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, and/or business intelligence is a plus.
* Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, or dbt in any environment (coursework, personal project, or prior role) is a plus.
* Exposure to data modeling concepts or BI tools (Tableau or similar) is a plus


\#LI\-Hybrid


At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. Citi Analytics \& Information Management (AIM) team is a global community that objectively connects and analyzes information, to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. The Anti Money Laundering (AML) Data Science \& Model Management (DSMM) analyst will be a part of AIM, based in Bangalore and reporting into the VP leading the team.
   

  

 The scope of work includes all aspects of analysis performed by the team within different projects: Threshold Tuning, Segmentation and data modeling/validation efforts depending on current needs and project plans. A primary area of focus for this position will be working on threshold tuning for Optimization, developing Logistic Regression Model to predict customer behavior, identifying anomalies in transaction and Customer behavior, Outlier detection, ATL threshold tuning, Segment customers into homogenous groups using clustering, Logistic Regression Model Performance Review while maintaining flexibility to switch amongst work streams based on business needs.
   

  

 The DSMM statistician will follow the globally consistent methodology but is expected to have a high level of initiative and creativity and suggest enhancements to the current methodologies. The role requires working closely with business partners based in other geographies that Citi operates in (e.g., NAM, APAC, and LATAM).
   

  

 Requirements include a background in analysis using databases, warehouses, data processing, experience with statistics and data mining. Experience and knowledge in banking and finance, especially in the AML area will be a plus. In addition, the ability to read and create formal documentation is highly desirable.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* A primary area of focus for this position will be working on threshold tuning for Optimization, developing Logistic Regression Model to predict customer behavior, identifying anomalies in transaction and Customer behavior, Outlier detection, ATL threshold tuning, Segment customers into homogenous groups using clustering, Logistic Regression Model Performance Review etc. while maintaining the flexibility to switch amongst work streams based on business needs. Apply quantitative and qualitative data analysis methods; prepare statistical and non\-statistical data exploration and advanced statistical analysis to support the threshold tuning or segmentation work streams.
* Validate data, identify data quality issues (if any), and work with Technology to address them. Analyze and interpret data reports, draw conclusions and make recommendations answering specific business needs.
* Automate data extraction and data preprocessing tasks. Perform adhoc data analysis. Design and maintain complex data manipulation processes. Provide consistent documentation and presentations.
* Develop new transaction monitoring scenarios based on emerging Financial Crime Risk
* Document solutions and present results in a simple comprehensive way to non\-technical audience, as well as write more formal documentation using statistical vocabulary.
* Generate new ideas, concepts and models to improve methods of obtaining and evaluating quantitative and qualitative data. Identify relationships and trends in data, as well as any factors that could affect the results of research. Question and validate assumptions. Escalate identified risks and sensitive areas in terms of methodology and processes.

* 2\-4 years of experience in Financial Services / Analytics Industry
* Masters in a numerate subject such as Mathematics, Operational Research, Business Administration, Economics etc. from Premier Institute or a track record of performance that demonstrates this ability.

* Experience in threshold tuning for Optimization, developing Logistic Regression Model to predict customer behavior, identifying anomalies in transaction and Customer behavior, Outlier detection, ATL threshold tuning, Segment customers into homogenous groups using clustering, Logistic Regression Model Performance Review while maintaining the flexibility to switch amongst work streams based on business needs
* Good Knowledge in Python, SQL, Hive
* Experience in prompt Engineering \& Generative AI.
* Strong statistics and data analytics academic background and knowledge of quantitative methods
* Highly skilled and good knowledge of MS Excel. VBA experience is a plus
* Experience in reporting the results of analysis in clear written form, and in presenting the findings during meetings and conference calls
* Team working experience (demonstrated team player ability required)

* Very good written and verbal communication ability in an educational style. Ability to express thoughts and concepts clearly.
* Ability to work well with a variety of people and to show team\-player attitude regardless of the scope of responsibilities.
* Provide input into the innovation of new and enhanced approaches. Having initiative and a proactive attitude is desirable

 At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play.  Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.
   

  

 Join us and be part of the play!
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Words With Friends Instant is seeking a Principal Data Analyst to be the analytics owner for the game: the person product, design, and engineering come to for data on player behavior, feature health, experimentation, and game strategy. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data\-driven insights.
   

  

**Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience**
* Product Strategy: Analyze long and short\-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
* Experimentation: Design statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
* Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance


**What You'll Do**
* Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
* Analyze player behavior to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with other disciplines to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
* Communicate findings and recommendations to senior and executive stakeholders, translating complex analyses into clear decisions and influencing product and game strategy at the leadership level.
* Support the team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
* Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
* Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
* Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first\-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.
* Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.
* Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which aims to significantly increase each analyst’s impact through the power of LLMs
* Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
* Minimum of 8 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably with 6 years in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
* Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
* Proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Demonstrated experience in data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
* Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.
* Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
* Highly self\-motivated with a keen interest in problem\-solving.
* Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
* Strong communication skills \- you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus


**Bonus Points**
 Experience in gaming, mobile, or consumer tech industries.

* World\-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.

 You will be staffed on active client engagements focused on health care value with the ultimate goal of making healthcare better, affordable and accessible for billions of people around the world.
   

  

 You will join our Client Capabilities Network in Bengaluru office as part of the Healthcare Access, Quality, and Outcomes (HALO) domain within the Social, Healthcare and Public Entities (SHaPE) practice.
   

  

 Our team uses healthcare data (payer/provider/third party data etc.), advanced analytics (combination of descriptive \& predictive analytics), advanced technologies (automation, digital, AI) and core consulting skills to answer some of the most pressing questions our healthcare payor clients face. HALO has been a fast\-growing domain, bringing together a diverse mix of healthcare experts, data scientists, engineers, and more to drive enterprise transformation programs across the healthcare value chain.
   

  

 SHaPE fosters innovation driven by advanced analytics, user experience design thinking, predictive forecasting to develop new products/services and integrating them into our client work. You will also support the development of HALO’s Intellectual Property (IP), knowledge \& product development, and drive the process of creating end\-to\-end solutions.
   

  

 You will own data models that you or your team creates, develop deep healthcare content expertise and develop a consulting tool kit – all of which are critical in solving the overall business problem. * Entrepreneurial mindset with a focus on continuous learning and team development
* Client service orientation and operational rigor, with the ability to perform in fast\-paced, high\-pressure environments
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels
